general1.event: You're jealous of the living trainees who get to wake up back in the Clan every morning.

general2.event: You can't remember the last time you weren't sore when you woke up.

general3.event: You grind your canines as you're turned away from the medicine cat for your attitude.

general4.event: You feel smug as you win another battle, regardless of your injuries.

general5.event: You feel anger course through you as you inspect your paws for fading.

general6.event: You come back to camp with nothing in your jaws, reminiscing of the times when you'd catch three mice in a hunt.

general7.event: You don't remember how warmth feels.

general8.event: You sharpen your claws every day, knowing you'll never get to use them on what you want to.
